title: The Runway Begins Here: Meet Omansh Gupta
excerpt: Nine years old and in Grade 3, Omansh Gupta is just beginning to discover what it feels like to own a room. His first runway walk came at a school Trash-to-Fashion competition. From there, he stepped into IBC Super Kids, a talent hunt for children aged 3 to 12, and found a new kind of excitement. With a family rooted in the event world and a confidence that is growing with every step, Omansh’s story is not about titles. It is about a young star finding his stride.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;

mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
line-height:normal"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI">Standfirst:</span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:none;mso-fareast-language:
EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI"> Nine years old and in Grade 3, Omansh Gupta is
just starting to discover what it feels like to own a room. His first steps on
a ramp came in a school classroom turned catwalk. Now he has a talent hunt
behind him, and plenty of curiosity left.</span></p>

<div class="MsoNormal" align="center" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:center;
line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI">

<hr size="1" width="100%" align="center">

</span></div>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI">Every fashion story has a
first moment, a single walk that changes how a person sees themselves. For
Omansh Gupta, it came at school.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI">The occasion was a
Trash-to-Fashion competition, where everyday discards were reimagined as
wearable ideas. Omansh stepped onto the ramp for the very first time. The
lights, the audience and the quiet before the first step all arrived at once,
and he walked anyway. What began as a school activity became his first real
taste of style, self-expression and the thrill of the stage.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI">That spark led him to <b>IBC
Super Kids</b>, a modelling talent hunt for children aged 3 to 12. There,
Omansh stood among young hopefuls from different backgrounds and got his first
experience of a proper talent show: the preparation, the nerves and the
excitement of waiting in the wings. For a nine-year-old, it was a first look at
the wider world of fashion and entertainment.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI">Glamour is not entirely
new to him. Omansh comes from an entrepreneurial family that runs its own event
business, so celebrations, stage setups and presentations have always been part
of his surroundings. Growing up near the craft of creating occasions may
explain how comfortable he looks when all eyes turn his way.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI">Still, his story is not
about trophies or titles, and it does not need to be. At nine, the real work is
discovering who you are. Omansh is learning how to carry himself, how to hold
his nerve and how to enjoy the moment, which are lessons that outlast any
single show.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI">The road ahead is long
and open. Fashion, modelling and entertainment are all there if he wants them,
and he has all the time in the world to decide.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI">For now, one thing is
certain. A first walk, a new platform and a growing confidence are enough to
start with.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
line-height:normal"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI">Omansh Gupta’s story is
only beginning.</span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:"Times New Roman";mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-IN;mso-bidi-language:HI"></span></p>
